method: Every word-boundary hit for LAHAJA, and every Svarah hit outside ESIC/EPFO/CoWIN, printed with +-40 characters of context and read by Claude on 2026-11-12. Row indices are positions in the concatenated parquet shards as loaded by dhvani.eval.datasets.load_*_ground_truth_texts. Awaiting owner confirmation.

per_entity.note: all genuine: portal login / certificate / registration commands

all 12 are the common Hindi noun आधार 'basis' (mostly 'के आधार पर' = 'on the basis of'), never the ID. A homonym: word boundaries cannot separate it; the bare Devanagari variant is ambiguous on its own.

datasets.substring_only_aadhaar_hits: 11, all false: 9x आधारित 'based on', 1x आधारशिला, 1x आधारभूत. The Sep 23 audit's \w-regex recount (21 Aadhaar, 38 total) let आधारित through because Python's \w treats the vowel sign ि as a boundary.

notes: ESIC (35), EPFO (22), CoWIN (15) are templated command utterances naming the entity; not individually re-read beyond spot checks.

UPI: 7 of 10 examples say 'UPI' as a word; 3 match only via a payment-address suffix ('...@upi'). Kept in the 94, flagged as borderline: whether ASR output of a VPA counts as recognising the entity is a 3B-2 scoring decision.
Provident Fund (5), Jan Dhan Yojana (3), Voter ID (2), Aadhaar (1), Ayushman Bharat (1): all genuine. One Provident Fund example also contains the typo 'EFPO' in ground truth.
